author: Art
text:
Warmed up with some random RBDs and DBRs.

Observations:

1. Structure in isolation.

RBD = Rally Base Drop and DBR= Drop Base Rally

Formation consists of 3 parts. Some questions to think about while searching for RBD/DBR:

a. Was there a strong rally? b. Was there a sharp Drop?

Or did price chop away consuming SD. Structure in isolation will be next thing to research.

Haven't noticed anything particular about bases.. they come in differen forms. Some have clean extremes, some don't... What leads to the next observation.

2. Was the RBD/DBR a source fo anything significant.

i.e. was the RBD/DBD a decision point?

and lastly... seems financial arena works in the same manner as real estate market:

3. Location Location Location.

If price hits HTF supply... would be stupid to expect that DBR would be anything more than best case scenario scalp trade... And vice versus with HTF demand... RBD should cause a tiny reaction or should be consumed.
